# Code of conduct

This project adopts the [Rust Code of Conduct](https://www.rust-lang.org/policies/code-of-conduct). Everyone is held to the same standard of conduct when interacting in these repositories as if they were rust-lang repositories.

## Enforcement
Please contact the maintainers to call attention to code of conduct violations.

Note that while we elect to follow the Rust Code of Conduct, this is *not* an official Rust venue, and consequently enforcement of the code of conduct in these repositories is not the responsibility of the Rust moderation team.
